label: Watch the jet streams concerning the volcanoes
description: An instruction to watch the jet streams in connection with the volcanoes, given alongside a plan to control Europe and Italy and images of the Vatican and Rome. He calls the jet streams unusual.
aliases: Watch the jet streams concerning these volcanoes

label: National monuments and treasures burned across Europe and England
description: An awakening of a giant across the land that will happen across Europe and in England, with national monuments and national treasures being burned, described as a culture being attacked.
aliases: national monuments, national treasures like trying to burn them
This will happen across Europe. It will happen in England

label: Another meteor, very bright, seen over New York
description: Another and bigger meteor coming that will be very bright and will show up over New York, given alongside the One World Trade building and riots with buildings burning.
aliases: There's another meteor coming. This will be seen over New York
A bigger It will be very bright

label: A line of seismic activity from Juan de Fuca down into Nevada
description: A magnitude 4.1 outside Las Vegas read as the latest in a moving line of seismic activity running from the Juan de Fuca plate down into Nevada, which is said to be primed for movement.
aliases: a moving line of seismic activity from the Juan de Fuca down into Nevada

label: A virus smuggled from Africa into Detroit
description: A man bringing a virus from Africa into the United States at Detroit to make people sick, discussed as Ebola or mpox without settling which.
aliases: He was trying to bring in a virus from another country into our country

label: Flesh-eating screwworm detected in south Texas livestock
description: A parasitic fly whose larvae feed only on the tissue of warm-blooded animals detected in United States livestock in south Texas for the first time in decades, read out from a headline.

label: An island completely engulfed with fire for the oil
description: After an escalation, an island seen completely engulfed with fire for the oil, given alongside reports of American self-defence strikes against Iranian drones and missiles. He says he does not know whether the reported strikes are it.
aliases: I saw the island completely engulfed with fire for the oil
I don't know if this is it

label: Men emerging from the New York sewers
description: Police investigating videos of men mysteriously emerging from New York City sewers, read out from a headline and joked about.
aliases: videos of men mysteriously emerging from New York City sewers
